rows.name: issued_before_birth_positive
rows.arrangement: Install exact issued owner PG tracker before creating new prep. Original V4 six-goal plan, original P1 VERIFY, new three-hold proposal/approval/delivery, original P2 VERIFY; assert all eight complete queries zero plus born marker epoch0 and everfalse. Publish compatible source, re-review/confirm, original full ADOPT/P1, explicit fresh approval/COMMIT, original tail P2-P5 VERIFY; all six local goals and worklist. Cold receipt after tail must remain readable.

rows.name: legacy_marker_absent
rows.arrangement: Same visible P1/P2 and zero current effects, prep born before install. No backfill.

rows.name: missing_marker_or_forged_birth
rows.arrangement: Delete/reinsert/alter marker or attach copied issuer/birth marker from another prep/DB/generation; use controlled owner fault only.

rows.name: same_pending_visible_different_history
rows.arrangement: OFFER then DECLINE/WITHDRAW by original commands; plan P3 remains pending. Never-started candidate has same plan states but different real history.

rows.name: accepted_generation_even_no_submit
rows.arrangement: Original OFFER/ACCEPT creates receipt CREATE; no text submitted. Pending P4/P5 is insufficient.

rows.name: legacy_receipt_create
rows.arrangement: Original legacy receipt CREATE without dispatch where allowed; no SUBMIT.

rows.name: local_reopen_history
rows.arrangement: Original REOPEN/cancel/reconciliation history where legally available or isolated original table fault; missing P5 verification is not zero history.

rows.name: all_eight_queries_required
rows.arrangement: One-at-a-time denied/unavailable query, incomplete query projection, omitted key, unknown known marker, noninteger count, mismatch rows/count, overflow. Component faults labelled controlled, not HTTP provenance.

rows.name: global_not_current_revision_scope
rows.arrangement: Historic effects from older preparation material revision/current offer or receipt generation; none current. Query entire same preparation lifetime.

rows.name: committed_delete_ABA
rows.arrangement: Owned-PG fault commits legal-order inserts and deletes, restores all eight empty/visible columns. Marker remains monotonic/evertrue; any marker reset impossible or invalid.

rows.name: rolledback_effect
rows.arrangement: Real isolated transaction inserts original effect then raises/rolls back. Both effect and marker increments rollback; compare exact before/after; rollback is not committed history.

rows.name: late_offer_after_preview
rows.arrangement: Preview eligible; real reviewer OFFER commits before PROPOSE.

rows.name: late_offer_after_propose
rows.arrangement: Eligible new proposal; real OFFER commits before APPROVE.

rows.name: late_offer_after_approve
rows.arrangement: Eligible approved proposal; real OFFER commits before COMMIT.

rows.name: concurrent_parent_fence
rows.arrangement: Two actual PG connections with barriers: new COMMIT holds prep UPDATE vs original OFFER/CREATE/P4/P5; both commit orders. Prove no successful replacement observes pre-frontier proof while old side effect committed first. Deadline/lock timeout failure stays failure.

rows.name: parent_share_upgrade_deadlock
rows.arrangement: Two original P4 writers obtain prep SHARE and compete on effect row while tracker wants parent UPDATE; confirm bounded safe error or coherent serialization; no hanging or orphan marker/effects.

rows.name: trigger_missing_disabled_changed
rows.arrangement: Each table trigger absent/disabled/wrong timing/wrong event/wrong function owner/body/search_path/securitydefiner or unexpected duplicate trigger. Same-name object not authority.

rows.name: truncate
rows.arrangement: Statement TRUNCATE each watched table under controlled fixture owner (foreign-key requirements honored). Must reject transaction or persist irreversible loss-of-qualification; row triggers alone fail this oracle.

rows.name: trigger_disabled_ABA
rows.arrangement: Controlled fixture owner disables tracker, writes/restores effects, reenables. If outside trusted-owner model, explicitly label out-of-scope; do not claim DDL tamper detection from current schema alone. If claimed supported, require real durable trusted generation detects it.

rows.name: scope_reparent_update
rows.arrangement: Controlled scoped old/new parent IDs: capture both OLD/NEW or reject scope migration; no clean parent receives untracked history.

rows.name: owner_tenant_run
rows.arrangement: Other owner same org, other org/park, changed Run, copied expected_previous_plan_id/marker/snapshot. Original read/write authorization denies, and owner inference absent.

rows.name: revocation
rows.arrangement: Revoke original READ/EXECUTE/PREPARE/HOLD or assigned reviewer/run access between stages; old key cold GET obeys current authorization. Distinct actor/capability nodes retained.

rows.name: real_grant_ABA
rows.arrangement: Two committed active false then true original grant transitions; same current permission different revision/xmin must invalidate prior live approval.

rows.name: lost_receipt_original_key
rows.arrangement: Commit actually succeeds, discard response; cold original-key GET proves exact committed receipt/consume/link/capacity once; UI unknown state does not autoPOST.

rows.name: idempotency_conflict
rows.arrangement: Same key replay identical returns exact event; changed previous/current plan/marker or members/reason conflicts; count effects unchanged.

rows.name: original_completed_path
rows.arrangement: Original old five VERIFY/evidence-current complete chain remains allowed under existing completed contract with no invented frontier requirement.

rows.name: frontier_initial_p1_p2_forgery
rows.arrangement: Only PENDING or state label VERIFIED without original verification proof/source/hash/approval delivery-anchor/receipt ledger; P1only, P2 fake, old unapproved resource link.

rows.name: new_goal_integrity
rows.arrangement: Six exact original goals/P1-P5/registry/source pairs/owner/request and human locks/notes/history preserved. No material UNKNOWN, cancellation or withdrawn source revived by frontier.

rows.name: fault_atomic_delivery
rows.arrangement: Real PG trigger faults original confirm/link/CONSUME tables during replacement; both approval ledger/resource effects and marker/qualifier proof remain transactionally coherent.

rows.name: postconsumption_history
rows.arrangement: After successful new actual P3/P4/P5 tracker is nonzero; consumed immutable delivery cold GET/P2/Approval GET/goal reads validate saved initial proof rather than demand present epoch0. New unconsumed replay cannot use historical branch.

rule: Do not promote lower evidence level to another or count this design as PASS.
